worldcombat.skill.armthrust.summary: A series of open-palmed shoves that never miss: one thrust after another drives the target forward, and anything it is pushed into a wall, stone or tree trunk for extra slam damage. Drive mode follows the target to land the whole string; planted mode holds ground and sends it much farther in one shove.
worldcombat.skill.armthrust.use.0: A string of sure-hit open-palm shoves
worldcombat.skill.armthrust.use.1: Push the target into a wall, stone or tree trunk for an extra slam
worldcombat.skill.armthrust.use.2: Drive mode follows the target to land the whole string
Each thrust deals %1$s physical damage, and the string throws up to %2$s thrusts (2-5 natively, set by the user's data); this move never misses.
It reaches a target within %1$s blocks and each thrust drives it about %2$s blocks along the push, with %3$s between thrusts.
When the target is driven into a wall, block or tree trunk it takes an extra %1$s slam, and drive mode follows %2$s blocks per thrust.
worldcombat.skill.armthrust.drive.on: Drive: each thrust is followed by a step forward that pulls the distance back into reach so the whole string lands more often; costs per-thrust power x0.9 and push x0.75 (so it drives less far and slams less often).
worldcombat.skill.armthrust.drive.off: Planted: hold ground with per-thrust power x1.15 and push x1.6, sending the target into a wall in one shove; costs the gap it opens after each thrust, so the string often ends early, and cooldown +3 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.armthrust.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.armthrust.growth.0: From level %1$s the per-thrust power rises to %2$s and the string grows to %3$s thrusts.
worldcombat.skill.armthrust.growth.1: From level %1$s the per-thrust power rises to %2$s and the slam to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.armthrust.growth.2: From level %1$s the per-thrust power rises to %2$s and the push to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.armthrust.preference.d: On (drive): each thrust is followed by a step forward that pulls the distance back into reach so the whole string lands more often; costs per-thrust power x0.9 and push x0.75 (so it drives less far and slams less often). Off (planted): hold ground with per-thrust power x1.15 and push x1.6, sending the target into a wall in one shove; costs the gap it opens after each thrust, so the string often ends early, and cooldown +3 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.armthrust.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first.
Prefer targets with an obstacle behind

On: a target with a wall, stone or tree trunk right behind it ranks higher because it gets driven into it and takes the extra slam; a target with open ground behind ranks lower. Off: all targets score the same.
On: the user will leave its station for Arm Thrust; off: it only casts when already in reach.
world_combat.move.armthrust.text.out: The target was driven out of reach (%1$s thrusts landed)
